viraja.p: [Vi+raja] (ti) CL=7 Virajasa-saṃ. Viraja-sakkatapiṭaka.] (1) without attachment, who hasn't passion such as lust; he. (2) without passion such as lust that is (Magga, Phala, Nibbāna). (3) without dirt (such as mist) that is (face etc.,) (or) clean complexion. (4) many tiered named Viraja.
